description: This file defines multiple search tools for GitHub entities such as repositories, code, users, and organizations. It includes functions to create these tools with schemas, handle API calls, and process responses, utilizing the github and jsonschema packages.

methods.name: SearchRepositories
methods.description: Creates a tool for searching GitHub repositories with schema validation and API call handling.

methods.name: SearchCode
methods.description: Creates a tool for searching code across GitHub repositories with schema validation and API call handling.

methods.name: SearchUsers
methods.description: Creates a tool for searching GitHub users with schema validation and API call handling.

methods.name: SearchOrgs
methods.description: Creates a tool for searching GitHub organizations with schema validation and API call handling.

methods.name: userOrOrgHandler
methods.description: Generic handler for user or organization search, adding type filter if missing.
